messages:
Maya: Quick brief request — need a 1-page field asset for webinar follow-up comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private for regulated buyers. Skimmable, security-first, include one benchmark stat and 4 talking bullets. Due EOD Mon.

Rohan: I can do the comparison table (latency / cost / control / SLA) + one-line SLA summary.

Liz: Benchmark nugget from last run (test config in footnote):
```
model=mid, seq=3072, mixed prompts, 4k samples
Hosted p99 = 115ms, est $7.5 / 1M tokens
Dedicated p99 = 82ms, est $5.0 / 1M tokens (reserved)
Private p99 = 105ms, est $6.8 / 1M tokens (infra-dependent)
```

Priya: Draft bullets (short):
- Exec: "Match deployment to compliance needs — turnkey hosted to locked-down private."
- Eng: "One API and SDKs across modes keeps dev velocity intact."
- Security: "KMS/HSM, encryption at rest, VPC options, and per-route audit logs."
- Procurement: "Hosted = pay-as-you-go, Dedicated = reserved monthly, Private = license + support."

ops-bot: Placeholder: attach SOC2/ISO artifacts when available — https://redwood.example.com/compliance (placeholder).

Rohan: Add a one-line resilience note: "Automatic routing and fallback policies keep apps online during regional or capacity issues."

Maya: Design wants a compact 3-column table + tiny latency bars and a footer with the test config line. We'll gate as webinar asset.

Priya: CTA: "Watch the webinar replay + download the brief [link placeholder] — book a 15-min infra walkthrough."

Liz: Uploading bench sheet to shared drive after this. Footnote to include: `model=mid, seq=3072, batch=28, 4k samples`.

Maya: Timeline: Rohan/Liz finish content by Fri noon, Priya polishes tone by Fri 5pm, design handoff Sat AM. Any blockers?

Rohan: None.

Priya: None.

Liz: None, will post link when done.

Maya: Thanks team :rocket:
